_description: Backtrader-specific config for replaying a trained RL agent via Approach B: the SB3 model is called live inside a bt.Strategy.next(). State vector parameters (tickers, dates, indicators, hmax, normalization stats) are inherited from source_config to guarantee the runtime state matches what the policy was trained on.

commission._notes: type='percentage' uses bt.broker.setcommission(commission=value, percabs=True, stocklike=stocklike). type='fixed' uses absolute $ per share. Set value=0 to disable.

slippage._notes: type='percentage' -> set_slippage_perc(perc=value, ...). type='fixed' -> set_slippage_fixed(fixed=value, ...). type='none' disables slippage entirely. apply_to flags map directly to backtrader's slip_open / slip_limit / slip_match / slip_out parameters.

broker._notes: check_submit -> bt.broker.set_checksubmit; rejects orders that would overdraw cash. allow_short -> bt.broker.set_shortcash; default false matches the long-only training env. coc (cheat-on-close) -> bt.broker.set_coc; if true, market orders fill at the close of the SAME bar instead of the open of the next bar.

execution._notes: order_type accepts 'market', 'limit', 'stop'. Limit/stop need extra price logic and are kept here as a placeholder. round_shares converts (action * hmax) to int (matches StockTradingEnv). hmax_override lets you scale the agent's action amplitude differently from training (e.g. for stress tests). min_order_size suppresses near-zero trades that just churn fees.

state_reconstruction._notes: use_source_indicators=true reads data.indicators from source_config — required for the state vector to match training. If you trained with normalize_observations=true (per source_config), set vecnormalize_load='auto' to auto-load models/vecnormalize_<algo>.pkl and apply the same z-score transform inside next(). Set vecnormalize_load='off' to skip normalization (only safe if source_config.normalization.normalize_observations=false). 'manual' + a vecnormalize_path lets you point at a custom stats file.

pyfolio._notes: Requires pyfolio installed; when enabled emits returns/positions/transactions DataFrames compatible with pyfolio.create_full_tear_sheet.

logging._notes: verbosity in ('silent','info','debug'). log_every_trade prints each fill to stdout — noisy for long backtests.
